decks.notes: This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly defeat the opponent. The key strategy involves rapid deployment of threats like Tarmogoyf and Monastery Swiftspear while supporting them with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. Mishra's Bauble and Abundant Harvest provide card advantage and consistency, while Underworld Breach offers graveyard recursion. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of synergy and flexibility to the deck. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo ability of the card Living End to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming your opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle through your deck and set up the combo, as well as disruptive cards like Force of Negation and Faerie Macabre to protect your strategy. The deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver your opponent with its combo potential.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures and playing cards that allow you to cascade into your combo piece, Living End, to bring back all of your cycled creatures from the graveyard. It also includes cards that disrupt your opponent's game plan, such as Force of Negation and Faerie Macabre. By cycling through your deck quickly and efficiently, you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and control the board to secure victory.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful blue and white cards like Narset, Teferi, and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key card, The One Ring, allows the player to set up a powerful enchantment that can provide card advantage and control the board. Supporting cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending offer removal options, while Leyline Binding helps lock down the opponent's threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck focuses on outlasting the opponent and dominating the game through careful control and manipulation.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of red, blue, and green cards. It aims to control the board with counterspells and removal while leveraging powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact helps to pump up creatures and protect them from removal spells. The deck also uses Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board presence, allowing for a quicker victory.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana to cast Primeval Titan and trigger its ability multiple times in a turn, fetching lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. With the help of cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate a large amount of mana and play multiple lands per turn, allowing for explosive combos and overwhelming board presence. Additionally, cards like Tolaria West and Expedition Map help tutor for key lands to further enable the combo.

The deck focuses on using cycle creatures and various spells to fill up the graveyard before casting Living End to bring out powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield. The key is to efficiently cycle through the deck to set up the perfect turn to cast Living End and overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures. The deck also includes cards like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

The deck focuses on using cascade spells like Ardent Plea and Shardless Agent to cheat out powerful creatures like Architects of Will and Curator of Mysteries. By cycling through cards with Street Wraith and Grief, as well as using Force of Negation to protect key pieces, the goal is to fill up the graveyard with creatures to eventually cast Living End and bring them all back onto the battlefield for a massive swing. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Subtlety and Faerie Macabre to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up the combo.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly cast low-cost spells to build up prowess triggers on Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, while also utilizing Slickshot Show-Off and Soul-Scar Mage to deal damage and control the board. The deck also features a combo with Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig for key cards, while Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal and burn to finish off opponents. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on using creatures as a toolbox to assemble a specific combo, with cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Chord of Calling, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serving as key pieces. By utilizing cards like Delighted Halfling, Grist, the Hunger Tide, and Wall of Roots, players can search for the necessary combo pieces while controlling the board with creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Young Wolf. The deck also includes various lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Underground Mortuary to support the combo strategy and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

The main concept of this Amulet Titan deck is to efficiently ramp mana using Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands, allowing the player to quickly play powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck utilizes Primeval Titan to search for key lands and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect important spells. The deck also includes The One Ring as a win condition and Cultivator Colossus for additional utility. Overall, the deck focuses on explosive mana generation and powerful land synergies to overwhelm opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, while disrupting their game plan with Thoughtseize and Not Dead After All. The deck also incorporates removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to maintain control of the board. With a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and secure a victory before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly aggression and disruption, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Thoughtseize to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief help control the opponent's resources while maintaining board presence. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with threats efficiently. The land base is optimized for consistency and access to both red and black mana sources. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cards such as Indomitable Creativity, Persist, and Transmogrify to create powerful creature tokens like Archon of Cruelty and Bitter Triumph. The strategy involves quickly setting up the combo pieces using cards like Thoughtseize and Wrenn and Six to control the game and find the necessary cards. With a mix of land destruction and burn spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while assembling its combo pieces to overwhelm them with a creative and unexpected win condition.

This control deck focuses on using countermagic, card draw, and removal spells to control the opponent's board while accumulating resources and card advantage. The key card, The One Ring, serves as a win condition by providing a powerful effect that can turn the tide of the game in the player's favor. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to further disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain control of the game. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and protect the win conditions until victory is achieved.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and card advantage. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.
